execution_protocol.answer_receipts_required: Question/history/response/evidence/verification binding hashes, final saved response, outcome, server-derived citation metadata, distinct draft/verifier model identities and sanitized retrieval/cache/provider-call telemetry. Raw private provider tokens must not appear in routine logs.
execution_protocol.cache_and_recovery: Observe cache write/read token receipts rather than assuming a hit; replay a completed operation and require identical saved/streamed/recovered response hashes with zero additional paid calls.
execution_protocol.failure_recording: Record SYSTEM_ERROR and refusals as coverage failures for otherwise answerable turns, separately from factual correctness of any released answer. Retain failed runs and do not tune from them in this run.
execution_protocol.history: Use actual persisted prior turns and operation IDs only; save each outcome before submitting the next related turn.
execution_protocol.release_identity_required: Exact current source commit, serving freeze SHA, backend/UI immutable image digests, runtime lock, manual/index identities and index object generation/SHA.
execution_protocol.retrieval: Record authenticated Qdrant plus BM25 first-stage execution, actual ranks, conditional rerank reason/calls and history query binding. Agreement and disagreement gates are also established by provider-free tests; this finite live set need not force a disagreement.
execution_protocol.reviewer_delivery: Coordinator supplies saved-answer receipts after hosted calls; reviewer checks exact final claims against freshly inspected original pages and records each outcome. No source approval or public-release acceptance is inferred from this plan.
execution_protocol.session_selection: Use actual confirmed Himalayan+BS6 selection without invented year/edition questions. Cases02-05 share one real session in sequence; cases01 and06 use separate fresh sessions.

original_page_inspection.method: Fresh full-page Poppler PNG rendering and visual inspection, plus PDF metadata/checksum verification. No index extraction was used to establish factual criteria.
